manifest.description: Four-provider parallel web search with source cleaning, content extraction, evidence checks, and automatic summary fallback.
config.hint: Configure search defaults and the connection for each source.
config.globalHint: Control default sources, the result workflow, and content handling.
config.providersHint: Enable each source and configure credentials as needed. Disabled sources are skipped for both default and explicit searches.
config.configured: Configured; leave empty to keep it
config.exaKeyHint: API auth provides a higher quota; Exa MCP remains available when empty.
config.tinyfishKeyHint: Used for TinyFish search and content extraction.
config.codexModelHint: Choose from models provided by codex-oauth.
config.toggleHint: Disabled sources are skipped for both default and explicit searches.
config.summaryModelHint: Choose any model currently available to Ki; clear to disable automatic summaries.
provider.codexDescription: Reuses the codex-oauth OAuth credential; no separate key is required.
provider.exaDescription: Uses free MCP without a key; an API key unlocks a higher quota.
provider.tinyfishDescription: Used for web search and content extraction; an API key is required.
provider.duckduckgoDescription: Public search with no authentication or self-hosted service.
